article.headline: Miami takes on Atlanta, aims to end 4-game skid
article.description: Miami Heat (0-4, 15th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Atlanta Hawks (2-2, seventh in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Miami takes on Atlanta, aims to end 4-game skid
article.linkText: Miami takes on Atlanta, aims to end 4-game skid
article.story: Miami Heat (0-4, 15th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Atlanta Hawks (2-2, seventh in the Eastern Conference) Atlanta; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Miami heads into the matchup against Atlanta after losing four in a row. Atlanta went 46-36 overall and 27-25 in Eastern Conference play last season. The Hawks averaged 118.5 points per game last season, 51.6 in the paint, 20.7 off of turnovers and 18.1 on fast breaks. Miami went 43-39 overall and 27-25 in Eastern Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Heat averaged 120.9 points per game last season, 54.7 in the paint, 19.6 off of turnovers and 18.4 on fast breaks. INJURIES: Hawks: Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot). Heat: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
